text: Over the past decade archaeological excavations have been carried out in the Mosfell Valley with the support of the town of Mosfellsbær. Professors Jesse Byock and Phillip Walker, the directors of the Mosfell Archaeological Project, have led a team of scholars that are conducting research in the valley. This team is international and interdisciplinary, employing the tools of archaeology, anthropology, osteology, forensic archaeology, environmental science, metallography, genetics, zoology, micromorphology, paleoethnobotany, history, and saga studies.
